members.identity_basis: Uploaded MSD_SUMMARY.json raw_identity and CSV_historical_row, plus uploaded report; individual CSV files do not embed mp/run/temperature identifiers.

interface_displayed_model_note: The model label actually shown in the user interface was not independently accessible or verified.
analysis_basis: Only the 13 uploaded allowed files for trajectory evidence; external primary literature is separated from this run. This is a review of saved derived tables, not a new coordinate-level simulation or independent scientific acceptance.

new_calculations.method: Group by window and reference; calculate endpoint mean/min/max/median, mean(endpoint_A squared), count(endpoint_A>2), and endpoint_A squared divided by the sum across 32 Na; compare with saved JSON.
new_calculations.scope: 672 rows; seven windows and three references
new_calculations.limitation: Endpoint contributions only; not all-lag MSD decomposition or coordinate-level recalculation. Existing r90/max/path/return fields were read, not regenerated.

new_calculations.method: Count return states; deduplicate control_id; convert times using round(t/0.02) to saved-frame indices and test each control including +/-10 frames against every same-Na candidate expanded closed forbidden interval.
new_calculations.limitation: Controls, overlapping phases and windows are not independent repeats; no new event detection or return-rate model.

new_calculations.method: Check saved-frame coverage of closed +/-200 fs phases; recalculate set Jaccard as intersection size/union size relative to the event/control start; reproduce event/control CN means, endpoint F6 J, nearest-Sb endpoint changes and endpoint distance.
new_calculations.limitation: Original six null fixed200 rows and all return labels/right censoring preserved. A sample-count versus closed-endpoint convention remains unresolved; no missing samples filled.

new_calculations.method: Join on window/Na0/radius_A/region; verify sum(n_blocks)=observed_200fs_blocks; count regions, residence episodes and repeat episodes; examine radii 0.8/1.0/1.2 A.
new_calculations.limitation: Region coordinate reference not independently established; only within-Na label/time comparisons. No cross-Na site universe, vacancy fraction or new coordinates. Nominal block duration is not added observation time.

new_calculations.method: Group 183 saved rows by host exclusion radius; calculate mean open_fraction and open_rank frequencies; compare saved times near selected events.
new_calculations.limitation: Only saved global geometric summaries; no reconstructed grid, interaction energy, barrier or proof of Na passage.

inputs: The 13 uploaded files listed in input_files
new_calculations.method: Compute SHA-256 of the actual uploaded bytes.
new_calculations.limitation: No hashes or reads of missing or restricted inputs; matching derived tables is not independent scientific acceptance.

not_performed: Reading, hashing or reconstructing species_displacements.csv, msd_curves.csv, msd_fits_diagnostic.csv, host_motion.csv or equivalent copies
New AIMD, DFT, NEB, model training or unvalidated coordinate construction
Strict1000 reconstruction, MSD curve reconstruction, new diffusion-coefficient fitting or room-temperature conductivity extrapolation
Independent verification of original raw-trajectory generation, complete Sb-F periodic contact graphs or full host-motion statistics
New plotted figures or new crystal-site models

external_primary_sources.access_scope: Publisher-indexed abstract and introduction/conclusion snippets; direct publisher page returned 403. Full text and supporting information not completely read.
external_primary_sources.use: Separate-sample NaSbF4 conversion/composite-electrolyte evidence, not validation of mp-29269/run performance.

external_primary_sources.access_scope: Publisher-indexed abstract and highlights; direct publisher page returned 403. Full text, supporting information and raw electrochemical curves not completely read.
Publisher full-text page accessible; abstract, experimental and structure discussion inspected.
external_primary_sources.use: NaBiF4 endmember and water-sensitivity precedent; not proof of Bi substitution stability or enhanced Na transport in NaSbF4.
General occupational Sb exposure risk; not NaSbF4-specific toxicology or safety authorization.

limitations: One nominal 1200 K run with a reported startup temperature spike; independent thermal histories and low-temperature measurements are absent.
Individual CSV material/run identity is inherited from uploaded summary/report rather than self-contained identifiers.
Nearest-F identity changes do not distinguish Na passage from F motion or establish causality; local fixed-F reference changes do not establish true jumps.
No complete shared Na-site universe, site capacity, actual vacancy density, Na-Na collective exchange sequence or migration free energy.
Sb main/secondary-contact graph statistics and full-host RMS in the old report remain report-only claims, not newly independently verified data.
Geometric openness and periodic rank are not diffusion dimensionality or low-energy paths.
Proposed compositions and balanced reactions are hypotheses; actual valence, occupancy, phase stability, electronic transport and electrochemical reversibility remain unverified.
